steps.caption: Open Buildings in the sidebar and choose Skyline Business Park – Tower 2.
The Intelligence panel shows one quote and one client option on record. Open it.
Unknown: developer, landlord and property manager are not recorded, so they are not guessed.
The summary says plainly: the latest terms are a historical quote, not current pricing.
Recommendations: the quote from February is out of date — ask the landlord for refreshed terms.
Another recommendation: two buildings were rejected because of parking, so filter future options on parking.
Latest known commercial terms: rent 78, CAM unknown, with the date it was quoted.
Historical quotations: every version with its date and validity. Old quotes are history, not today's price.
Availability observations and rent / CAM changes, as they were seen over time.
Client interest: which requirements this building was proposed for, and the result.
Rejections and reasons: 'client said no' is the client's own decision, from the site-visit feedback.
'did not fit' means our matching ruled it out — it is not a client decision.
The reason is kept: not enough parking for the team. Shortlists for this client will warn about it.
